discoveredDuring: Task 12 Step 2 (Gate 8.2 device-switch live acceptance test)
attribution: PRE-EXISTING. Present in shipped v0.5.0. NOT introduced by, and NOT fixed by, the feature/device-capture-trust branch.
scope: Out of scope for this release. The device-switch defect this branch closes (see simulator-window-title.json and the deviceSwitchDefect entry it documents) is a different bug: it is about the WRONG device being reported/loaded after a switch. This defect fires with NO device change at all.

steps: 2. run_app(projectPath: Tests/fixtures/testapp, device: <deviceX>, rebuild: true) -> returns sessionId N. get_logs(sessionId: N) returns real lines, including the fixture's own markers (e.g. FIXTURE_STARTED, FIXTURE_SCREEN_WIDTH <width>).
3. run_app with the SAME device again (no device change, so simulatorRestarted is correctly false) -> returns a NEW sessionId N+1.
4. get_logs(sessionId: N+1) returns zero lines, with state: "running", crashDetected: false, exitCode: null, terminationReason: null. Reading again after a delay still returns zero lines.

5. Independently confirmed the relaunched app is genuinely running, not crashed or hung before its first frame: a screenshot during the zero-lines window shows the fixture's normal rendered content, and `ps` shows exactly one live monkeydo/java process for that PRG.

observations.note: Reproduces byte-for-byte on the release the consumer already has installed. This is the observation that establishes the defect predates this branch.

notKnown: Whether the app's console output is actually LOST (never produced, or produced and discarded somewhere in the simulator/monkeydo pipeline) or merely UNROUTED (produced and sitting somewhere get_logs for the new session never looks). Not distinguished by anything observed here.
Whether an intervening sim_stop/sim_start (as opposed to a same-device run_app relaunch with no restart) is the only thing that restores log capture for a following launch. Not tested.

Whether this is specific to a same-device relaunch specifically, or would also occur on any relaunch that does not go through restartForDeviceChange's simulator-process replacement. Not tested beyond the same-device case.
reframesConsumerReport: The original consumer report (the one that motivated this release, ground truth in simulator-window-title.json's deviceSwitchDefect) listed 'get_logs returned lines: [] for the phantom session' as a symptom of the device-switch bug (A1). Given this defect fires with no device change at all, some of what the consumer attributed to A1 was probably this second, independent bug instead.
